docs.title: pytree-stats
docs.text: A small Python command-line utility for generating directory tree listings. Use it to inspect folder hierarchies, share file structure snapshots, or compare directory layouts across projects.

docs.title: What the project does
docs.text: pytree-stats reads a filesystem path and prints a tree-style view of the directory contents. It is designed as a lightweight, easy-to-run Python script that works without complex setup.

docs.title: Why the project is useful
docs.text:
• Quickly inspect folder structure from the terminal
  • AI-Friendly: Generates structured output that is easy for LLMs to parse.
  • Useful for documentation, code reviews, and project audits
  • Works cross-platform with Python
  • Simple, no heavy dependencies

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository:
git clone https://github.com/JohannesL2/pytree-stats.git
cd pytree-stats
  1. Install dependencies using the requirements file:
pip install -r requirements.txt
  1. Run the script
python tree.py
